text:
Cameron: FYI PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8773 is queued but blocked by the 2x-approver rule before the 10:00 PT cutover. Tests pass locally, I included a small kv-cache fix in the last push (commit 3a7f1d). Can reviewers take a quick look? I can rebase if needed.

Ana: On it, will do a quick review in ~15m.

Bryan: Skimming now. If infra review is needed I'll ping @Dana.

Dana: infra looked at the change, generally fine. Left one comment about a potential race during warmup — seems minor.

Cameron: pushed a tiny fix for the race, force-pushed `branch: fix/kv-warmup-race` — PTAL.

Bryan: LGTM from me :+1:.

ops-bot: ci/circleci: all checks passed. perf-check: token throughput within 3% of baseline.

Emily: Quick note — policy requires two distinct reviewer approvals before cutover. QA already gave a green earlier. If folks are stretched, I can provide the release-manager approval to satisfy the second eye as long as QA + infra are green.

Cameron: That would unblock us. Emily, can you drop a confirmation here so I can merge right before the window?

Emily: QA and infra both confirmed earlier. I'm comfortable signing off as release-manager for this cutover — approved :rocket:.

ops-bot: merge-policy: criteria met (2 distinct approvals) -> auto-merge enabled.

Cameron: Merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!
